newsitem.title: USA: Baxter files $700 mln shelf in debt.
newsitem.headline: Baxter files $700 mln shelf in debt.

text.p: Baxter International Inc said Tuesday it filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $700 million in debt securities.
The proceeds will be used for working capital purposes, to repay existing debt for capital expenditures and for general corporate purposes, the filing said.

The Deerfield, Ill., company is engaged in worldwide development, manufacture and distribution of products, systems and services for hospitals, patients at home, laboratories, industrial research and manufacturing facilities.
